description: Named install shapes for a consumer repo. Four, not seven: the honest shapes for one organization's repositories are just-analysis, the-whole-thing, gating-only, and in-a-band.

context-only.description: Repo context generation and the structural graph. No pipeline, no memory sync, no hooks. For a repo that wants /orchestrator-init and /analyze and nothing else.

standard.description: The default. Full SDLC pipeline, all skills, shared memory, the hook runtime at the standard profile.

reviewer.description: Review, security, and verification only. For a repo where the orchestrator gates pull requests but does not write code.

band-member.description: A repo participating in a cross-repo band. Adds registry sync and contract hand-off to standard.

note: A profile is a starting point, not a cage. connect-repo.ps1 accepts -With and -Without to adjust any profile at install time; the resolved set is recorded in .github/orchestrator-install.json so `repair` can reproduce the intent rather than guess at it.
